answer: Epoch 2: Sybil defense via web-of-trust vouching. Every new account must link, through signed attestations, to established nodes; a score derived from karst-like branching paths decides what it can earn. Fake identities that wander alone earn nothing, and mass-created ivory towers of sockpuppets collapse, because each vouch costs real social capital. Account age and diverse, genuine ties then form a hard-to-fake history: sybil farming stays cheap to detect but ruinously expensive to scale, while honest newcomers climb as their trust graph deepens.
